items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: The interviewee (Dick Griffin) does not mention Rashied Ali in his response. The mention of Rashied Ali is solely in the interviewer's question, where the interviewer states 'I asked Rashied Ali...'. The interviewee only confirms the interviewer's summary ('Yes. That’s right.') and proceeds to tell

ctx.x: I asked Rashied Ali, I was trying to understand the motivation or the inspiration for playing what — I’ll use your term, avant garde and I wondered if he, with his fellow musicians sat down and had a conversation about making the music more exploratory or adventurous. Did you talk about it? And he said no. We didn’t ever talk about it. We just did it. But he went on to say that the music that they were doing was a reflection of the times. And he related some of the segregation things he had experienced, and he…
